title: Amblyopia treatment (eye patch, vision training)
what: With amblyopia, one eye sees worse even though the eye itself is healthy. It is trained by covering the strong eye and doing exercises.
why: If one of your child's eyes sees much worse even with glasses, with a squint, or with a big difference in prescription between the eyes.
duration: one session usually takes 15 to 40 minutes; treatment lasts months
tell_doctor: If your child wears glasses and for how long
How many hours a day your child wears the patch
If your child had treatment before
If the patch irritates the skin

prepare.title: Glasses
prepare.text: Glasses must be worn all the time. Without them, treatment does not work.

prepare.title: Patch
prepare.text: The doctor sets the patching schedule. Keep to the hours, even if your child resists.

prepare.title: Your child
prepare.text: Explain that it is a game and a workout for the eye.

bring: The eye patch, if you already use one
Your patching diary, if you keep one
steps: The doctor checks the vision in each eye
A patching schedule and daily hours are set
Your child looks at pictures or plays games on special machines
The doctor notes changes and adjusts the plan
feel: Children can find the patch unpleasant and uncomfortable
The patch may irritate the skin. Tell the doctor
after: At home, use the patch and do the tasks as planned
It is best to patch during drawing, games, and reading
Checkups are usually every 1 to 3 months
The earlier you start, the better the result

faq.q: Until what age can amblyopia be treated?
faq.a: Treatment works best in preschool and early school years. But it can help later too. The doctor decides.

faq.q: What if my child takes off the patch?
faq.a: Distract them with something fun and praise them. If it still does not work, ask the doctor about other options.

reminders.text: Amblyopia treatment visit tomorrow. Bring the glasses and the patching diary.
